 Netherlands Name Squad for ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 Matches Against Oman and UAE 
 The Koninklijke Nederlandse Cricket Bond (KNCB) has announced its 15-player squad for the next round of the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2, where the Netherlands will face Oman and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
 The top four teams in the Cricket World Cup League 2 will advance to the 2027 Global Qualifier; fortunately for the Netherlands, they already have a guaranteed spot in that tournament.
 The Netherlands squad: Colin Ackermann, Shariz Ahmad, Noah Croes, Cedric de Lange, Bas de Leede (captain), Daniel Doram, Aryan Dutt, Scott Edwards (wicketkeeper), Fred Klaassen, Kyle Klein, Michael Levitt, Zach Lion-Cachet, Max O’Dowd, Timm van der Gugten, Paul van Meekeren.
 "We are looking towards the tournament in the United Arab Emirates, where we will be concentrating on our pattern to form a better squad that can move in the future to develop toward the foundation that already exists” Netherlands men national coach Ashley Noffke said.
